title: centaurea panormitana subsp. aegusae
intro: Centaurea panormitana subsp. aegusae, commonly known as Aegusae Caltrop or Sicilian Star Thistle, is a plant species within the Asteraceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of digestive issues and skin problems. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea panormitana subsp. aegusae include antioxidant and antiseptic effects, which may contribute to its potential in reducing oxidative stress and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which may be responsible for its medicinal properties.
